deciding_body: the Disciplinary Chamber of the QDC of Zakarpattya
outcome: the applicant’s licence to practise as an advocate was suspended for six months
supporting_quote: On 17 April 2013, in the applicant’s absence, the Disciplinary Chamber of the QDC of Zakarpattya suspended the applicant’s licence to practise as an advocate for six months

outcome: the decision of 17 April 2013 was upheld
supporting_quote: On 16 May the QDC of Zakarpattya upheld the decision of 17 April 2013.

outcome: the draft decision to annul the suspension was rejected
supporting_quote: On 22 July 2016 the draft decision was put to vote at a HQDCB meeting... the draft decision was rejected and the decisions suspending the applicant’s licence remained valid.

deciding_body: the Podilskyy District Court of Kyiv
outcome: the court decided not to examine the applicant’s appeal
supporting_quote: On 22 December 2016 the Podilskyy District Court decided not to examine the applicant’s appeal.

outcome: the examination of the appeal lodged on 5 October 2016 was suspended
supporting_quote: On 16 February 2017 the Kyiv District Administrative Court granted the request and suspended the examination of the appeal of 5 October 2016.

deciding_body: the Kyiv Administrative Court of Appeal
outcome: the decision of 22 December 2016 was quashed
supporting_quote: On 6 March 2017 the Kyiv Administrative Court of Appeal quashed the decision of 22 December 2016.

outcome: the court found that all the decisions issued by the self-government bodies of the Bar against the applicant had been lawful
supporting_quote: On 8 April 2021 the Kyiv District Administrative Court found that all the decisions issued by the self-government bodies of the Bar against the applicant had been lawful.
The applicant’s appeals were rejected (final decision of the Supreme Court of 9 December 2021).
